name: calendar
useFor: Use to pick a day, several days or a range (a delivery log window, a report period) when the month view helps. Set mode to single, multiple or range, pass selected and onSelect, and disable days that cannot be picked. For a field that opens a calendar, use Date Picker.

title: Calendar
